paragraphs: Quester Tangent manufactures, supplies, and integrates passenger train technologies for new train build projects and for midlife renewal of existing fleets. The product line pairs Trainwise, an onboard train control and monitoring system (TCMS) and passenger information system (PIS), with Fleetwise, a wayside enterprise fleet management system (EFMS).

Train manufacturers fast-track production using integrated Trainwise TCMS and PIS technology tailored to the needs of each project. Transit authorities and operators use Fleetwise EFMS to connect from the wayside to the onboard Trainwise TCMS and PIS of every train in a fleet. The fleets named are subway, LRV, and commuter rail, and the systems serve drivers, operations, maintenance, and engineering teams.

Operations teams determine fleet readiness and see train faults in real-time, while maintenance teams triage service affecting repairs and automate system software updates. Quester Tangent states more than two decades of passenger train experience and thousands of units in revenue service with major transit authorities. Delivery covers hardware and software design, manufacturing, project management, and turnkey delivery with integration and in-house engineering services for all types of train networks.

quote.text: Our unique ecosystem unifies onboard Trainwise® TCMS and PIS with the wayside Fleetwise® enterprise fleet management system.
